title: Knock-down wall
done: Crash! Down came the wall. Build it up and do it again.

steps.say: Put a big green square flat on the table. It is a road with two lanes!
Put a big yellow square flat in front of it, going away from you. The road gets longer.
A little way past the road, stand a red square up on the table. The back of the wall.
Stand an orange square up next to it, in the middle.
Stand a yellow square up next to that, on the right.
On the left end, stand a blue square up, turned to face the road. A side for the wall!
On the right end, stand a green square up, turned the same way. Now the wall has two sides.
Stand a purple square on top of the red one. Just stacked, not joined!
Stand a red square on top of the orange one.
Stand an orange square on top of the yellow one.
Stand a yellow square on top of the blue side.
And a blue square on top of the green side. The wall is done!
